title: Open tensor normalizations and the product proper/open projection identity
statement:
Fix the finite coefficient datum $k,A=A_{E,n}$ of [def-pur-conventions]. Use ordinary unbounded constant-$A$ module derived categories on the small pro-etale sites, with $P_v=Lv^*$, $R_v=Rv_*$, derived tensor $\otimes=\otimes_A^L$ and signed symmetry $\sigma$ [def-weil-derived-pullback-tensor-hom]. Let $f:X\to B$, $g:Z\to B$ be separated finite-type morphisms of separated finite-type $k$-schemes, and choose compactifications $f=aj$, $g=bk$, with opens $j:X\hookrightarrow\bar X$, $k:Z\hookrightarrow\bar Z$ and proper maps $a:\bar X\to B$, $b:\bar Z\to B$ [def-weil-compactifications-refinements]. Put $P=X\times_BZ$, $C=\bar X\times_B\bar Z$, $W=\bar X\times_BZ$ [def-pc-fibre-product]. Write $p:P\to X$, $q:P\to Z$, $r:C\to\bar X$, $t:C\to\bar Z$, $v:W\to Z$, $i:W\hookrightarrow C$, $j_q:P\hookrightarrow W$ for the canonical projections and opens; put $u=ij_q$, $h=fp=gq$, $c=bt=ar$. For $M\in D^+(X_{\mathrm{proet}},A)$, $N\in D^+(Z_{\mathrm{proet}},A)$ equipped with etale-origin witnesses [def-weil-pbc-etale-origin-witness], set $H=j_!M$, $J=k_!N$, $D=P_pM\otimes P_qN$, $F=P_rH$, $E=P_iF$, $K=j_{q!}P_pM$, $K_D=j_{q!}D$, $m=i_!K$, $L=R_aH$ and $L_0=P_bL$ [def-weil-extension-by-zero]. Use the specified counit-defined maps $\pi,\operatorname{Ex}_*,\operatorname{Ex}_!,\operatorname{PF}$ of [def-exchange-projection]. All omitted tensor, pullback and direct-image compositors are canonical; the direct-image compositor is $\kappa_{b,t}:R_c\xrightarrow{\sim}R_bR_t$ [lem-weil-derived-direct-image-composition].

Use the unit-normalized open base change $\beta:E\xrightarrow{\sim}K$ and open tensor maps $\delta_{o;Q,V}:o_!Q\otimes V\xrightarrow{\sim}o_!(Q\otimes P_oV)$ of [lem-sf-open-tensor-normalization], and the normalized proper/open mate $\Gamma:k_!R_v\to R_ti_!$ of [lem-sf-proper-open-tensor-compatibility]. Write $\epsilon_o:o_!P_o\to1$ for the open-adjunction counit. Set $A_0=\operatorname{Ex}_{*,a,b,H}:L_0\to R_tF$, and let $B_0=\operatorname{Ex}_{!,f,g,M}:P_kL_0\to R_vK$ use the compactification $(j,a)$ and its base change $(j_q,v)$. Put $\chi=\epsilon_{i,F}i_!(\beta^{-1}):m\to F$ and $s=\Gamma_Kk_!(B_0):k_!P_kL_0\to R_tm$.

Identify $P_kJ\cong N$ by the open unit. Define
$$\nu=k_!(\sigma_{N,P_kL_0})\delta_{k;N,L_0}\sigma_{L_0,J}:L_0\otimes J\xrightarrow{\sim}k_!(P_kL_0\otimes N),\qquad \eta=\epsilon_{k,L_0}\otimes1_J:k_!P_kL_0\otimes J\to L_0\otimes J.$$
Put $d=\delta_{j_q;P_pM,P_vN}:K\otimes P_vN\xrightarrow{\sim}K_D$, with the pullback compositor inserted, and
$$w=i_!(d)\delta_{i;K,P_tJ}:m\otimes P_tJ\to u_!D.$$
Let $e:F\otimes P_tJ\xrightarrow{\sim}u_!D$ be the two-stage open base-change/tensor comparison through $X\times_B\bar Z$, normalized to restrict to $1_D$ along $u$, as in [lem-pur-finite-open-product-swap]. Define
$$\Psi=\Gamma_{K_D}\,k_!R_v(d)\,k_!(\pi_{v;K,N})\,k_!(B_0\otimes1_N):k_!(P_kL_0\otimes N)\to R_tu_!D.$$
Then $\eta$ is an isomorphism and the actual specified maps satisfy
$$\nu\eta=\delta_{k;P_kL_0,J},\qquad w=e(\chi\otimes1_{P_tJ}),$$
$$\Gamma_{K_D}k_!R_v(d)\,k_!(\pi_{v;K,N})\,\delta_{k;R_vK,J}=R_t(w)\,\pi_{t;m,J}(\Gamma_K\otimes1_J),$$
$$\Psi\nu\eta=R_t(w)\,\pi_{t;m,J}(s\otimes1_J).$$
Under the open unit identifications, the restrictions of $\eta$, $\nu$ and $\delta_{k;P_kL_0,J}$ to $Z$ are the identity on $P_kL_0\otimes N$; their source and target lie in the fully faithful image of $k_!$. Both maps in $w=e(\chi\otimes1)$ have source canonically isomorphic to $u_!D$, target $u_!D$, and restrict to $1_D$ on $P$. These identities use ordinary derived tensor and require no constructibility or finite Tor amplitude. The sources of $w$ and $e$ are respectively $m\otimes P_tJ$ and $F\otimes P_tJ$; $\chi$ is not assumed invertible.

proof.text: Apply exactProperOpenProjectionMate to (i,v,t,k), K and N. Postcompose by R_t i_!(d) and by the canonical open compositor. Naturality of Gamma at d and functoriality of R_t identify the two composites with delta followed by projectionTail and (Gamma_K tensor 1) followed by projection_t and R_t(w). This is the proved private projection_pasting lemma. Properness and quasi-compactness are the base-change instances.

proof.text: Precompose the equation with (k_!(B0) tensor 1). The proved tensorMap_id_left/right and tensorMap_comp identities expose the bifunctor maps without unfolding its derived construction. Naturality of the published inverse open projection, followed by naturality of the exact/left-derived comparison, proves gamma_natural. Naturality in the inverse open unit then proves delta_natural, which moves B0 through delta. Substitute eta nu=delta, Psi=k_!(B0 tensor 1) projectionTail and s=k_!(B0) Gamma. Tensor functoriality gives precisely the fourth identity. Assemble all fifteen conjuncts.
